note: Every 2027-28 active-roster row on Spotrac's cap tables: `cap` is their cap hit (base + likely incentives), `unlikely` the bonuses Art. VII §3(d) excludes from Salary and §2(e)(1)(i) adds back for Apron Team Salary, `type` their contract label, `nonGuaranteed` when the guarantee column is blank. league.ts reads two things from it: the incentives, stamped on each player's 2026-27 row so the engine's apronTeamSalary reproduces their apron figure; and the cap hit, which replaces a figure the sheet only back-solved from a reported total when the two are within 25% (a filing beats a raise-shape assumption — Coby White's 3yr/$74M descends from $26.8M, Trae Young's starts at the max). Curated stated salaries and deemed minimums are never replaced. A re-run of scrape-external-rosters.mjs rewrites this file.
